Search summaries of Åre tourism, SkiStar and guide pages: 89 runs and 47 lifts across three areas (other results: 90–91 runs, 'around 41–50' lifts); about 100 km of pistes. Lifts include a nearly 3 km aerial tramway to the Åreskutan top area and the historic Bergbanan funicular from the village centre, plus gondolas, chairlifts and drag lifts (counts by type not found). Capacity not found.

character: Åre is Sweden's largest ski resort, on the Åreskutan mountain in Jämtland, run by SkiStar across three linked areas: Åre By, Åre Björnen and Duved/Tegefjäll. It has about 100 km of pistes, around 90 runs and 47 lifts, including an aerial tramway to about 1,274 m and the historic Bergbanan funicular from the village.
learning: Reference: Åre Björnen is the family and beginner-focused area; confirm SkiStar ski school and beginner-lift options for 2026-27.
